## Symptoms
Orders return 202 but never complete. The pricing consumer logs rejected orders mentioning a price mismatch between the quoted and current price.

## Likely causes
1. The quote the order service received is out of date compared with the price list the consumer checks.
2. A price list update was applied to one path but not the other.

## How to confirm
Compare the quoted price in a rejected order with the current price for the same SKU. If they differ by a constant ratio, quotes are stale.

## Fix options
Refresh the quote source so it matches the price list. Replay rejected orders only after approval.

## Escalate when
Mismatches affect every SKU, or continue after a refresh.
